item.name: Gets a list of all scheduled jobs in a compartment

request.name: Gets a list of all scheduled jobs in a compartment

description.content: Lists scheduled jobs that match the specified compartment or scheduled job [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm).

query.description: The OCID of the compartment that contains the resources to list. This filter returns only resources contained within the specified compartment.
A filter to return resources that match the given user-friendly name.
A filter to return resources that may partially match the given display name.
A filter to return only scheduled jobs currently in the given state.
The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance. This filter returns resources associated with this managed instance.
The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance group. This filter returns resources associated with this group.
The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed compartment. This filter returns resources associated with this compartment.
The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the lifecycle stage. This resource returns resources associated with this lifecycle stage.
A filter to return only scheduled jobs with the given operation type.
A filter to return only scheduled jobs of the given scheduling type (one-time or recurring).

A filter to return only resources with a date on or after the given value, in ISO 8601 format.

Example: 2017-07-14T02:40:00.000Z

A filter to return only resources with a date on or before the given value, in ISO 8601 format.

Example: 2017-07-14T02:40:00.000Z

For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a paginated "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `50`

For list pagination. The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `3`
The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.
The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending.
A filter to return only restricted scheduled jobs.
The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the scheduled job. A filter to return the specified job.
Indicates whether to include subcompartments in the returned results. Default is false.
A filter to return only resources whose location matches the given value.
A filter to return only resources whose location matches the given value.
A filter to return only resources whose location does not match the given value.
A filter to return only resources whose location does not match the given value.
Indicates whether to list only resources managed by the Autonomous Linux service.
The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the dynamic set. This filter returns resources associated with this dynamic set.

item.name: Triggers a scheduled job to execute immediately

request.name: Triggers a scheduled job to execute immediately

description.content:
Triggers an already created recurring scheduled job to run immediately instead of waiting for its next regularly
scheduled time. This operation only applies to recurring jobs, not one-time scheduled jobs.
